market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Oil shock + CPI reacceleration + Fed hike + bond rout create 4th consecutive loss day. S&P 500 below 50-day MA. Expect volatility to remain elevated through CPI reaction and Fed decision. Oil likely to test $110-115 if Houthi disruptions persist. Yields may push 30-year above 5%.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $110 and Fed pauses after 25bps hike. AI capex cycle (Dell $95B backlog) and defense spending provide structural growth. Clean energy oversupply and China competition create sector rotation. Consumer squeeze may moderate if energy peaks. 6-12 month: expect 10-15% equity recovery from current levels if geopolitical de-escalation occurs.
